column3: BSB supplies “intolerable”; the critical text has no verb after “among the pagans,” while the Textus Receptus has “is named” (ὀνομάζεται).
The passive removal is recast as the Corinthians actively removing him.
The second our is not expressed.
The infinitive deliver is rendered as a command; “his” specifies the spirit.
The new batch is explicitly described as “unleavened.”
The two separate leaven phrases are combined as old bread leavened with malice and wickedness.
The past wrote is rendered as “am writing”; being called a brother is rendered as claiming to be one.
